items.label: Android 15 OS + Gemini AI
items.value: The R500 tablet for adults and kids both, is Powered by the latest Android 15 system, enhances performance, efficiency, privacy controls, and security. Gemini AI is designed as a truly modern, multi-modal AI from the ground up. Which was built from the start to seamlessly understand and combine, such as Text, Images, Audio and Video. This allows for more sophisticated and context-aware tasks, like creating a presentation (text and images) from a video lecture.

items.label: Large Storage + Octa-core CPU
items.value: The Tablet comes with 30GB (8GB physical + 22GB virtual) RAM, ensuring a smooth operational experience and faster reading and writing capabilities. It features 128GB of internal storage and supports up to 1TB TF card expansion, which can easily store a variety of games, movies, photos, files, and more. It features a 2.0 GHz octa-core processor, providing a smarter optimized experience and excellent performance. You can easily handle various demanding tasks.

items.label: HD Eyes Protection Screen + Widevine L1
items.value: This Android 15 tablet features a 10-inch HD display with an high resolution of 1280x800 IPS, which brings you truer colors and clearer images. The tablet supports Widevine L1, allowing you to smoothly watch copyrighted content such as FHD and UHD content on Netflix, Prime Video, Hulu, and more. It provide the safer, higher-quality viewing experience.

items.label: EVA Case + Parental Control
items.value: The 360° rotatable folding Shock-proof Case is made of premium environmentally friendly EVA material, providing perfect protection and a comfortable viewing experience. Parents can easily manage the tablet via Family Link, such as app access rights, usage time limits, location, etc.

items.label: 8000mAh Battery + 5G Wi-Fi
items.value: The large 8000mAh battery of 10 inch tablet provides longer usage and standby time, and it charges through the USB Type-C port. The tablet supports dual-band 5G+2.4G WiFi and Bluetooth 5.0, ensuring a more stable wireless connection and faster transmission.

items.label: Ideal Gift
items.value: The JUEDUR tablet is suitable for all age groups; it has excellent performance, a stylish appearance, and elegant packaging, making it the best choice for Christmas, birthdays, and rites of passage. It is a gift for both adults and kids.
